title: anyone else like me?
content: I've been dreaming about the mall world my entire life, but only some dreams take place there. I wanted to list some consistencies in my mall world dreams and if anyone else has experienced these - Huge labyrinthine aquariums & aquarium stores (often the animals are not taken care of). - There's only one kind of department store and they're all huge. These stores sell random malicious cursed objects alongside the other merchandise. Everyone is already aware of this and avoids these products/objects without really worrying about it. - There is one house for every family, and the house "grows" rooms when a new family member is added. Rooms "die" when a family member passes away. - In general, almost every house I've been in within my dreams have had catacomb-like hidden rooms or basements. It seems really common for people to have thousands of objects saved from various stages of their life - A casino filled with flowing fountains (the kind you throw coins in) - A beach with clear blue water and a city that gets further when I try to walk to it. If I "die" in Mall World, I wash up here. There's also some kind of extremely exclusive strip club/brothel here? - Abandoned indoor playplace with a tunnel system throughout the building. It gets messier and more unkempt the deeper you go. This one creeps me out the most - Large multilevel "waiting rooms" for nothing in particular. Always filled with "people" that end up being malicious entities. There's more to it than that but that's what I remember off the top of my head. Something else about my Mall World is that everyone I talk to there seems to know that I only go there when I dream and misses me when I'm awake. Anyone else have similar experiences?
